summary: GSC Game World's Ukrainian survival-FPS series set around the Chornobyl Exclusion Zone, with PC originals, modern console trilogy ports, and the Unreal Engine 5 sequel.

entries.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Shadow of Chernobyl

primary.why: The Windows original remains the most flexible route for fixes, mods, and high-fidelity archival play; modern console ports are useful but less open.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release with current patches and only documented stability/visual mods; note whether using the original title or console-renamed Chornobyl branding.

entries.remaster_caveats: Document mods and title branding; do not treat fan restoration projects as official releases.

entries.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Clear Sky

primary.why: Clear Sky launched on Windows and later reached consoles through Legends of the Zone; Windows remains the most flexible fix/mod route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release with current patches and documented stability fixes; preserve mod list.

entries.remaster_caveats: Document fixes/mods; console trilogy ports are convenience routes.

entries.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl

primary.why: Heart of Chornobyl shipped on Windows and Xbox Series X/S, then PS5; Windows is the most configurable route for this Unreal Engine 5 entry.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows release through Steam, Epic, GOG, Microsoft Store, or Game Pass; document patch, DLC/expansion state, and settings.

entries.remaster_caveats: Document patch and DLC/expansion state; future multiplayer/expansion updates may change completeness.
